name: jaapbeus-plugins
description: Data integration tooling for Claude Code

plugins.name: bruno-gen-collection
plugins.description: Generates a Bruno API collection from your repository - from an OpenAPI, Postman or WSDL description when you have one, from your source code when you don't - and keeps it in sync without overwriting your edits. HTTP and REST only: GraphQL, gRPC and WebSocket are reported, not generated.
